listenEdit("editRequest", function(triggerId, data)
    for i = 1, #data do
        if data[i].role == "user" then
            data[i].role = "system"
        end
    end
    local assistantCount = 1
    for i = 1, #data do
        if data[i].role == "assistant" then
            if assistantCount > 4 then
                data[i].role = "system"
            else
                assistantCount = assistantCount + 1
            end
        end
    end
    mergeConsecutiveRoles(data)
    return data
end)
 
function mergeConsecutiveRoles(data)
    local i = 1
    while i < #data do
        if data[i].role == data[i + 1].role then
            data[i].content = data[i].content .. "\n" .. data[i + 1].content
            table.remove(data, i + 1)
        else
            i = i + 1
        end
    end
end
